rules.text: Ability: dexterity. Utilize: Mend a tear in clothing (DC 10), or sew a Tiny design (DC 10). Craft: Padded Armor, Basket, Bedroll, Blanket, Fine Clothes, Net, Robe, Rope, Sack, String, Tent, Traveler's Clothes. Tool proficiency adds PB to ability checks using the tool; if also proficient in a skill used with the check, gain Advantage. Each Artisan tool needs its own proficiency.
